```{r}
#| label: setup
#| message: false

library(tidyverse)

movies <- read_csv("data/movies.csv")
```

```{r}
movies <- read_csv("data/movies.csv")
glimpse(movies)
names(movies)
```

```{r}
movies |>
  summarize(across(everything(), ~sum(is.na(.))))
```

```{r}
movies |>
  filter(!is.na(boxOffice)) |>
  select(title, boxOffice) |>
  slice_head(n = 10)
```

```{r}
#| cache: true

movies_clean <- movies |>
  separate_longer_delim(genre, delim = ", ")

movies_clean
```

```{r}
movies_clean |>
  count(genre, sort = TRUE)
```

```{r}
movies |>
  summarize(mean_audience = mean(audienceScore),
            mean_critic   = mean(tomatoMeter))
```

```{r}
movies |>
  ggplot(aes(x = tomatoMeter)) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 5) +
  labs(title = "Distribution of Rotten Tomatoes Critic Scores",
       x = "Tomatometer Score",
       y = "Count")
```

```{r}
movies_gap <- movies_clean |>
  mutate(gap = tomatoMeter - audienceScore)

movies_gap |>
  select(title, tomatoMeter, audienceScore, gap) |>
  slice_head(n = 5)
```

```{r}
gap_by_genre <- movies |>
  separate_longer_delim(genre, delim = ", ") |>
  mutate(gap = tomatoMeter - audienceScore) |>
  group_by(genre) |>
  summarize(mean_gap = mean(gap, na.rm = TRUE),
            movie_count = n()) |>
  filter(movie_count >= 50) |>
  arrange(mean_gap)

gap_by_genre
```

```{r}
movies_gap |>
  summarize(mean_gap   = mean(gap),
            median_gap = median(gap),
            sd_gap     = sd(gap))
```

```{r}
movies_summary <- movies_gap |>
  summarize(mean_gap = mean(gap, na.rm = TRUE),
            n = n(),
            .by = genre) |>
  filter(n >= 100) |>
  arrange(mean_gap)

movies_summary
```

```{r}
movies_summary |>
  ggplot(aes(x = mean_gap,
             y = fct_reorder(genre, mean_gap))) +
  geom_col() +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, color = "red", linetype = "dashed") +
  labs(title = "Average Critic vs. Audience Score Gap by Genre",
       subtitle = "Positive = critics rate higher; Negative = audiences rate higher",
       x = "Mean Gap (Tomatometer − Audience Score)",
       y = "Genre")
```
